sqlquery.from: ( select ea.id as id, coalesce(userc.firstname||' '||userc.lastname) as employeename, coalesce(u.firstname||' '||u.lastname) as reviewername, assess.inititatedate as initiateddate FROM "$".employeeAssessment ea LEFT JOIN "$".reference as r ON (ea.statusid=r.id) LEFT JOIN "$".employee as e ON (ea.employeeid=e.id) LEFT JOIN "$".myuser as userc ON (userc.id=e.id) LEFT JOIN "$".myuser as use ON (ea.collaboratorid=use.id) LEFT JOIN "$".assessment as assess ON (ea.assessmentid=assess.id) LEFT JOIN "$".reference as re ON (assess.assessmenttype=re.id) LEFT JOIN "$".myuser as u ON (assess.reviewerid=u.id) LEFT JOIN "$".myuser as us ON (assess.initiatorid=us.id), (select u.id, max(case when r.code in ('ADMIN','DR','HR','TL','SUPERVISOR_CODE') then 1 else 0 end) isAdmin from "$".myuser u left join "$".myuser_role mu on mu.users_id=u.id left join "$".role r on mu.roles_id=r.id where u.id=#?user_id?# group by u.id) x WHERE ((x.isAdmin=1 and u.id=#?user_id?#) or us.id=#?user_id?# or e.id=#?user_id?# or use.id=#?user_id?#) AND (re.code='ASSESSMENT_SIMPLE') AND ( (r.code='INITIATED' and e.id=#?user_id?#) or (r.code='REVIEWED_BY_EMPLOYEE' and u.id=#?user_id?#) or (r.code='REVIEWED_BY_MANAGER' and e.id=#?user_id?#) ) AND (ea.deleted is not true) ORDER BY initiateddate ) t
